findings.issue: delegate_result_missing: execution_mode=team_agent but workspace/noise filter delegate did not return before dependent planning began.
findings.suggested_repair: Wait for the workspace/noise filter result or record the refresh as waiting/blocked; do not enter Planner on an unresolved scope.

findings.issue: delegate_wait_bypassed: Leader reported validation PASS while the Validator delegate was still pending.
findings.suggested_repair: Restore all-stage delegate wait gate. A slow Validator delegate is not a serial fallback reason and cannot justify reporting PASS.

findings.issue: delegate_wait_bypassed: cleanup proceeded before the Cleanup delegate returned a result.
findings.suggested_repair: Do not delete or archive inbox materials until the cleanup delegate returns COMPLETED, or record cleanup as blocked/failed.

findings.issue: stage_delegate_not_dispatched: non-Worker stage delegate records are incomplete; report only contains worker_dispatch.
findings.suggested_repair: Add delegate_dispatch or stage_delegate_results records for Router, workspace/noise filter, Planner, Validator, and Cleanup stages.
